protocol.build: one stock DEVSERVER build; ordinary main-menu boot and official frame-floor protocol
adaptations: Borrow one stock served build using --base; outer runner owns preview cleanup
Absolute imports into unchanged repo harness modules
Simulator additionally takes browser-lane around its sim-lane lease
protocol.comparison: progress/frame-floor/milestone-2026-10-13/summary.json; fea49ae28 standalone and second grid run
limitations: iOS Simulator is Mac-backed Safari, not physical iPhone performance
Rows are independent windows: median and p95 must not be pooled or averaged across poses
Historical comparisons span content and harness changes; matched reruns are required to attribute a new regression
Four instrumented non-reproductions comprise three CPU-profiled runs and one GL-only run; instrumentation can alter scheduling. No first-bad FPS commit was established.
The pregraph and midpoint controls are diagnostic comparisons, not substitutes for primary plain timings.

Previous milestone had no quiet window and higher/variable machine load. Safari travel misses were already present, but current worst frames and Signal/Driftwood single-run misses cannot be called unchanged.
notes: One stock pinned DEVSERVER build for all eight cohorts
Fresh browser/contexts per cohort, same standalone order and full milestone grid journey as 78254116d
Two plain passes expose intermittent events; this is not a controlled causal before/after experiment
All raw per-pose cases retained as normalized rows below; median/p95 are not pooled across poses

criteria.medianFps: Integer-rounded median >= 60 desktop / >= 30 Simulator; raw medianFps retained
criteria.p95Ms: <= 17.5 desktop / <= 35.0 Simulator; 1.05 times the nominal frame period
criteria.cpu: Each trusted content owner p95 <= one quarter frame: 4.167 ms desktop / 8.333 ms Simulator; shell and harness observers excluded
criteria.maxFrameMs: Every observed row: max <= 100 ms desktop / <= 200 ms Simulator

runs.measurement: Live game; rAF timestamps between observed drawn frameCount changes grade cadence; performance.now callback intervals retained as diagnostics, Game.frameMs/workMs and game.lastFrame retained. No frame limiter bypass, CPU throttling or capture clock.
